name: Ascent to Khazarad
desc1: The earth-packed lane becomes a little narrower and straighter here.
desc2: Now lined with heavy flagstones, it begins to climb up towards the
desc3: side of the mountain. The workmanship is quite different than that of
desc4: the earthy, homelike atmosphere in the gnome village-- straight lines,
desc5: precise measurement and impeccable craftsmanship have gone into this
desc6: well-planned road. The flagstone way climbs to the east, while an
desc7: earthen road enters the gnome village to the west.
